card.title: The Limited Time Offer
card.pretext: A recruiter from 'FastShip Jobs' calls a teen, saying they have a limited number of positions and need to fill them today. Offers $40/hour for receiving and reshipping packages.
card.caller_persona: Urgent, persistent, uses countdown pressure.
card.twist: The caller says they already have another candidate on the line and will give the position to whoever provides information first.
